hypotheses.title: Batch 83: Radical Uniqueness & Technique Diversification Push
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Breaks entirely away from the linear polynomial scaffold and signed_power template to radically maximize Leaderboard Uniqueness and eliminate cross-alpha correlation. Introduces three pure, structurally distinct quantitative paradigms: (1) Supply chain customer return propagation in pv13. (2) Market maker gamma downside support buffer in option9. (3) Multiplicative interaction of operational cashflow efficiency and analyst revision velocity in model16.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if customer return diffusion, option downside breakeven buffers, or multiplicative rank derivatives fail to achieve Sharpe >= 1.25 and Fitness >= 1.50 under subindustry neutralization.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Supply-Chain Customer Return Diffusion): Quantifies the lead-lag spillover where major customer equity returns propagate upstream to suppliers over a 10-day decay window. Zero template recycling; completely unmined relationship network domain.

Candidate 2 (Market Maker Gamma Support Buffer): Measures the percentage buffer between spot price and the 30-day open-interest weighted put breakeven price. Stocks trading safely above put breakeven enjoy positive dealer gamma drift.

Candidate 3 (Non-Linear Operational Cash & Revision Synergy): Pure multiplicative cross-sectional interaction isolating companies at the dual intersection of surging operational cashflow conversion and rapid sell-side consensus upgrades.
